proposals: The Department of Defence Production should publish one dated, reconciled figure for items indigenised and import-substitution value under PILs 1–4, stating whether it supersedes the 2023 release (2,736 items, ₹2,570 crore) or the 2024 one (2,972 items, ₹3,400 crore), so readers are not left choosing between the ministry’s own two numbers.

The Department of Defence Production should add a note to the SRIJAN portal explaining why cumulative “items offered” fell from over 36,000 in June 2024 to over 33,000 in June 2026, and republish the back series on the corrected basis, so a cumulative count is never seen to shrink without explanation.

The Department of Military Affairs should publish an import-substitution value for its 509-item, five-list series, using the same method as the DPSU lists, so the two programmes’ combined 5,926 items can be added up in rupees as well as in items.

The Department of Defence Production should post each Positive Indigenisation List notification, including the sixth list of 405 items, on its own website and through PIB on the day it is notified, so its item counts and stated ₹3,070 crore business potential can be checked against the primary document rather than trade reporting.
